map.计算中药指纹图谱与对照指纹图谱的相似度（相关系数/夹角余弦）: Computes the similarity between a Chinese medicine fingerprint and a reference fingerprint (correlation coefficient / cosine of the angle)
map.参照峰强 [120,130,110,90]，样品 [125,128,115,88: Reference peak intensities [120,130,110,90] and sample [125,128,115,88]: pearson about 0.998 and cosine about 0.999, taking the larger score about 0.999 above 0.95 to judge them consistent.
map.对照 [120,130,110,90]，异常样 [80,60,55,40]；pe: Reference [120,130,110,90] and abnormal sample [80,60,55,40]: pearson about 0.21, clearly deviant, indicating a charging or process deviation.
map.一般取 pearson 与 cosine 的较大值作为综合 score，避免单一: Generally take the larger of pearson and cosine as the combined score, to avoid a single index being unstable.
map.中药注射剂/提取物常要求相似度≥0.90~0.95，具体看法定标准。: TCM injections and extracts usually require similarity of 0.90 to 0.95 or above, depending on the pharmacopoeial standard.
